name: Chaos

movements.notes: to touch an elevated target bar (women use 25)

origin.summary: An event from the 2018 CrossFit Games. The CrossFit Games are the season's final championship stage, where the qualified field competes across multiple events to crown the Fittest on Earth. Games events are tests first and workouts second — many use loads, formats, or venues no affiliate would program, which is exactly why they make interesting benchmarks.

description: A six-movement chipper spanning the ski erg, burpees to a target, single-arm dumbbell overhead squats, alternating pistols, box jump-overs, and a heavy sled pull.
source_notes: games.crossfit.com/workouts/games/2018/9 (official CrossFit Games event), retrieved 2026-07-09; a "mystery" event -- athletes were not told the movements or reps in advance, discovering each station on arrival
